question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**knew**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'A wise counting'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**knew**'.
 
• The given passage is in the simple **past tense(V2)** so it must have a verb in its **past form.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *Birbal immediately smiled and went up to Akbar. He announced the answer, he said there were twenty-one thousand, five hundred and twenty-three crows in the city. When asked how he **knew** the answer, Birbal replied, "Ask your men to (4) ______ the number of crows. If there are more, then the relatives of the crows must be visiting them from (5) ______ cities. If there are fewer, then the crows from our city must be visiting their relatives who live outside the city".*
